mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.representativebanner.RepresentativeBannerMapper.getRepresentativeBannerList */ SELECT REPRST_BANNER_ID, TITLE, FILE_NAME_PC, FILE_NAME_MOBILE, LINK_URL, DECODE(USE_YN, 'Y', '사용', 'N', '중지') AS USE_YN, DISPLAY_ORDER, BANNER_CONTENT, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM FROM G_REPRST_BANNER WHERE PROCESS_TYPE = #{processType} ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER ASC
